zh.text: 11/8/26 當日隨想：我還以為無風險利率是風險大廈最底層的積木！引用了一則含 $NVDA 的帖文。

en.text: Musings of the Day, 11/8/26: And here I thought the Risk Free Rate was the bottommost Jenga block of the risk edifice! Quotes a post with $NVDA.

zh.text: 過去 10 年... NVIDIA $NVDA：+11,159%，比特幣 $BTC：+10,587%，$AMD：+6,745%，特斯拉 $TSLA：+2,720%，蘋果 $AAPL：+1,269%，微軟 $MSFT：+918%，谷歌 $GOOGL：+636%，亞馬遜 $AMZN：+588%，Meta $META：+410%，標普 $SPY：+313%，黃金 $GLD：+199%，美國通臀：+39%，美國債券 $AGG：+16%。

en.text: Last 10 Years... NVIDIA $NVDA: +11,159%, Bitcoin $BTC: +10,587%, $AMD: +6,745%, Tesla $TSLA: +2,720%, Apple $AAPL: +1,269%, Microsoft $MSFT: +918%, Google $GOOGL: +636%, Amazon $AMZN: +588%, Meta $META: +410%, S&P $SPY: +313%, Gold $GLD: +199%, US Inflation: +39%, US Bonds $AGG: +16%.

zh.text: @aleabitoreddit 分享 AI 拋售期間來自高通、Arm 至 Meta 高管的各種評論，包括 $LITE 行政總裁指出需求帳與市場拋售之間存在巨大脫節，$AMD 行政總裁表示需求高於供應且處於採用週期初期，$ARM 行政總裁談全球需求及美國與中國的競爭，$APLD 稱需求極為強勁儘管有融資風險，$QCOM 指是供應受限而非需求受限，以及 $META 談政治風險但有合作。總結：加速器、網絡和半導體公司極為看多；未見 AI 需求破壞的證據。

en.text: @aleabitoreddit shares various commentary from Qualcomm, Arm, to Meta executives during the AI selloff, including $LITE CEO noting massive disconnect between demand books and market selloff, $AMD CEO saying demand higher than supply and beginning of adoption cycle, $ARM CEO on global demand and US competition with China, $APLD on robust demand despite financing risks, $QCOM on supply-bound not demand-bound, and $META on political risks but cooperation. TLDR: extremely bullish from accelerator, networking, and semi companies; no evidence of AI demand destruction.

zh.text: @leadlagreport 表示大多數債券 ETF 只提供曝險，而 $JOJO 提供策略。當風險可能獲得回報時輪動至高收益，否則輪動至國債。設計用於收益加上定位。

en.text: @leadlagreport says most bond ETFs give you exposure while $JOJO gives you a strategy. Rotate to high yield when risk may be rewarded, rotate to Treasuries when it's not. Designed for income plus positioning.

zh.text: 美股盤前上漲（SPX +0.4%、NDX +0.3%），因特朗普對伊朗較為和解的言論令布倫特原油下跌1.1%至97美元/桶，抵消了NVDA因執行長黃仁勳承認與一名疑似中國間諜有長期婚外情而下跌4.4%的影響；董事會正在調查，但認為未洩露公司機密或危害國家安全。晶片需求預計未來數年將超過供應，NVDA 2027年市盈率19倍具吸引力。能源價格回落及標普2026年盈利增長強勁（同比+33%）意味著20倍市盈率，應支持股市。對TSLA保持謹慎，因其估值偏高、盈利下修及自動駕駛技術商品化。

en.text: US stocks rose pre-market (SPX +0.4%, NDX +0.3%) as Brent crude fell 1.1% to $97/bbl on Trump’s more conciliatory Iran comments, offsetting $NVDA’s -4.4% drop after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an extended affair with a suspected Chinese spy; board investigating but sees no secrets or national security compromised. Chip demand expected to exceed supply for years, $NVDA 2027 P/E 19x compelling. Easing energy prices and strong S&P 2026 EPS growth (+33% YoY) implying 20x P/E should support equities. Remains cautious on $TSLA due to stretched valuation, negative earnings revisions, and commoditization of autonomous tech.

zh.text: $OTIS 行政總裁：中國房地產改革正在結束開發商依賴客戶訂金資助建設的做法。對於任何預售，二十年來首次，那些首付款必須存入託管帳戶，因此不能用於資助下一個項目。

en.text: $OTIS CEO: China's property reforms are ending developers' reliance on customer deposits to fund construction. For any presales, for the first time in 2 decades, those down payments have to go to escrow, so they can't be used to finance the next project.

zh.text: 臺灣從聯發科到華邦電的每隻AI股似乎都漲停。加權指數：+4.94%，歷史第二大單日漲幅。市場對NVDA黃仁勳在這個年齡的活力印象深刻？

en.text: Every AI name in Taiwan from Mediatek to Winbond looks like its limit up. TAIEX: +4.94%, its 2nd largest daily gain in history. Market impressed by $NVDA’s Jensen Huang vitality at his age?
